capabilities.text: A whole sphere or a hemisphere
A hemisphere's flat face down like a dome or up like a bowl
capabilities.note: Checked by hand against the hemisphere face down.

capabilities.text: Label the radius or diameter with its measure
capabilities.note: Measure is the opening's own mode, so the evidence shows it on the diameter. Note: with give_d on, r_lab sets the diameter's label and d_lab renders the same either way.

capabilities.text: Label the radius or diameter with typed text such as r
capabilities.note: Checked by hand: the diameter reads d.

The dashed back of the middle circle, or left off
